steps.content: Impressive. You've held out for so long. Go easy on me, will you? You really want to win this much?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now that I know what power this... this creature has, I can't let it fall into your hands.
Maybe to her, this is just a game, but you know how much effort Moore has put in... It's rare to see her so serious and focused.
Why so serious... I still wish you'd treat it as a game. At least you'll have some fun.
She suddenly raises her hand, and the device you're in flies uncontrollably towards her palm.
You won't stand a chance when push comes to shove.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: 000?! What are you doing?! Didn't we agree on a fair showdown? This is cheating!
You struggle desperately, but to no avail.
Haha, the assassination game is over. You've won. I'll give you your reward later.
The next scene might be a bit brutal, so I won't show it to you for your own good.
There's one thing you're right about. I really need its power. Sorry, Chief.
(A dragon's howl. A girl stands in front of you, outside the "phone screen")

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Sorry, Chief, we came late. Leave the battle here to me.
